product_one_liner.value: DRUID AI enables enterprises to build, deploy and orchestrate AI agents that automate business processes and customer and employee interactions.

pricing_page.notes: The pricing URL offers custom quotes and a sales-contact flow, not published plans or prices; classified as false under the contact-form exception.

employee_band.notes: The profile reports 216 employees; band is based on that reported count rather than its broader company-size label.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog inventory did not establish two engineer-authored posts about how the product is built; it primarily presents product, use-case and industry content.

public_docs.notes: Public product documentation includes multiple governance, model-management and configuration articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable careers page lists Technical Consultant, not a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.value: Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Mistral AI, Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, LLaMA-compatible models, and DRUID’s proprietary Becus model.
model_provider.notes: These are publicly supported/configurable model backends, not a claim that every deployment uses all of them.

compliance_certs.notes: Publicly claimed compliance frameworks: the site names SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001:2022, alongside HIPAA and GDPR. These are company claims, not independent verification of certificates; HIPAA and GDPR are regulatory frameworks.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 16, 2025 round falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Business Development Representative posting in New York; the retrieved posting does not say applications are closed.

launched_6mo.notes: Druid 10.1 introduced a real-time bidirectional webRTC voice channel and ElevenLabs Voices, deployed October 8, 2026 to Community and October 22, 2026 to production clouds.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Reviewed leadership coverage and profiles, but could not verify a qualifying C-level or VP-level external join or departure within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026. The identified May 2026 VP of Product change was an internal promotion, not a company join.

crm_stack_signal.notes: HubSpot and LinkedIn Sales Navigator appear in BDR requirements; Outreach and Apollo are example outbound tools, not confirmed deployments. Salesforce and Microsoft Dynamics appear as integration signals, not evidence of internal CRM adoption.
